article: The city council voted on Tuesday to close the Elm Street bridge for repairs. Engineers found cracks in two support beams during an inspection in March. The bridge will reopen in October, and buses will use a detour along Oak Avenue until then. The repairs will cost 4.2 million dollars, paid from the state budget.
